tools.name: get_tariff_line
tools.description: Look up the duty on one Israeli tariff line on a date. HS tariff code: "07.10.210000", "0710210000" or the old 8-digit "07102100". Israel customs import duty read from the official gazette, by code only (no search by product name). Amounts are in ILS. A duty of kind ending in _bounded, or with a min

tools.name: get_tariff_history
tools.description: Every reading of the duty on one Israeli tariff line, with its dates and the gazette issue and page that set it. A temporary version overrides a permanent one while it applies; suppressions list windows in which permanent versions are hidden. HS tariff code: "07.10.210000", "0710210000" or the old 8

findings.detail: Tool "get_tariff_line" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
